typography.note: Bahianita display type is observed on home, Projects, methodology, governance, donate and contact; Red Hat Text supplies supporting text. Some live project-detail H1 elements match the DK Brush Crush CSS rule and H3 rules declare Acumin Pro Condensed. The kit uses the documented open-font pairing; the outlined logo lettering is separate artwork.

signatures.label: Complete pitch and wordmark
signatures.use: Preserve the complete source geometry and red flag. Positive black/red matches observed website usage; reverse white/red is the source PDF treatment.

logoPolicy.note: Conservative source-preservation controls for this kit. Only the complete black/red and white/red treatments are offered; the flag keeps its source red. Local recommendations start primary logos at 32 mm or 144 CSS px with one quarter of the full logo height reserved around them. These are not official minima or source-verified exclusion zones.

lockup.clearspaceRecommendation: Local recommendation: reserve one quarter of the complete artwork height on each side; keep the larger 8 mm reserve in document layouts. Start primary artwork at 32 mm in print or 144 CSS px on screen and proof the output. No official numeric minimum or clear-space standard was found.

applicationGuidance.status: Local recommendations informed by public website evidence; not organization-issued standards.

logo.enforcement: Recommendations, not source-verified export limits. Review secondary small marks and proof the actual output.
logo.rationale: One quarter of the full artwork height gives a scalable reserve without editing the paths. The official raster’s smallest transparent inset is about 0.259 of its visible artwork height, supporting this as an inference rather than an official rule. Screen sizes were compared as rendered specimens; the print starting size is a local design judgment requiring a physical proof.

display.use: Short display headings; keep diacritics and natural word spacing.

typography.status: Font roles are observed; this reusable scale is a local application choice.

layout.responsive: Use content-led wrapping: stack image/text and partner groups when readable widths no longer fit. Keep logical reading order.
layout.status: Local defaults, not extracted mandatory breakpoints or official grid ratios.

rules.title: Give the complete mark room
rules.basis: Local geometry-based recommendation, corroborated by source raster margins
rules.decision: Reserve at least one quarter of the complete logo height on every side. Document layouts retain their larger 8 mm reserve. Keep red flag, pitch and lettering together.
rules.limit: No official numeric exclusion zone was recovered; image padding alone does not establish one.

rules.title: Start at a practical readable size
rules.decision: Start primary logos at 32 mm in print or 144 CSS px on screen; use 48 mm for report covers. Small secondary marks need an output-size review.
rules.limit: These are recommendations, not official minima. A screen rendering is not a physical print proof.

rules.title: Separate colour evidence from readable use
rules.basis: Observed website roles plus calculated contrast
rules.decision: Keep green and light green for project surfaces, terracotta for emphasis, and cyan for an additional website accent. Use charcoal on these surfaces; reserve red for the source flag within this kit.
rules.limit: Website observations do not establish print conversions or fixed colour percentages.

rules.title: Use expressive titles and readable supporting text
rules.decision: Use Bahianita for short titles and Red Hat Text for paragraphs, labels, captions and numbers. Start web body at 18 px/1.5 and document body at 10.5 pt/1.45. Allow wrapping instead of squeezing translated text.
rules.limit: Some project-detail H1 elements match the DK Brush Crush CSS rule; browser font loading was not measured. This kit does not recreate or redistribute that face.

rules.title: Lead with the place and the people
rules.basis: Editorial synthesis of official project and methodology pages
rules.decision: Record project/community name, city and country, verified project identifier, status or reporting period, local leadership, activities, stewardship and evidence. Keep a proposed project distinct from an observed project profile.
rules.limit: Project numbers and locations need project-specific verification; global counters do not identify a project.

rules.title: Choose one primary action for each audience
rules.basis: Observed homepage audience routes; local content structure
rules.decision: Use a community enquiry for a proposed space, a partnership conversation for collaborators, a sponsorship conversation for project funders, and giving links for individual supporters. Specify the audience, destination and next step.
rules.limit: Verify current destinations and local-language routes. Campaign amounts and supporter programs are not permanent identity tokens.

rules.title: Keep partner attribution separate from the mark
rules.basis: Observed partner groupings; local layout convention
rules.decision: Use a separate acknowledgement area with named roles. Keep the full love.fútbol logo clear, give other approved marks their own space and balance prominence optically. Use text placeholders until approved assets and relationships are supplied.
rules.limit: No fixed official partner-logo size ratio or fused co-brand lockup was recovered.

rules.title: Show context and credit the image
rules.basis: Observed project storytelling; local editorial convention
rules.decision: Use real community-led activity, the space and its ongoing use. Provide a concise caption with place, date and creator. Keep essential text off busy images. For before/after comparisons, identify both dates and the same location.
rules.limit: Public images are research references, not a stock-photo licence; frames stay empty until suitable assets are provided.

rules.title: Attribute quotations precisely
rules.decision: Use a verified exact quotation with the speaker’s approved name or role, community, date and source. Identify any translation. Leave placeholder copy visibly instructional until it is replaced.
rules.limit: Do not invent testimonials or let a local quotation stand in for a measured population outcome.

rules.title: Keep the definition with the number
rules.decision: Pair every metric with its unit, geography or population, period, source and whether it is observed, estimated or a target. Use a dated source; distinguish visits, unique participants, annual reach and cumulative reach.
rules.limit: Inconsistent or undated site totals are not frozen into default assets.

rules.title: Preserve the identity across languages
rules.basis: Observed English, Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese routes
rules.decision: Keep love.fútbol unchanged. Preserve place-name accents, review translation with local speakers, adapt dates and numbers to the chosen locale, and keep each call to action in the destination language.
rules.limit: The kit remains an English authoring interface; locale guidance and glyph coverage do not imply a complete translated UI.

rules.title: Use recurring design evidence, review content inconsistencies
rules.decision: Record conflicting captions, inherited return-link labels and placeholder controls as source-quality observations. Confirm names and destinations against stronger project text before publishing.
rules.limit: A visible website inconsistency is not an identity rule to reproduce.

elements.text: PDF source treatment: white and red
The vector comes from love.fútbol’s 2025 guide published by U.S. Soccer. A single translation normalizes the canvas; the original paths and proportions remain intact.

elements.text: Supporting values: charcoal #1D1D1B, dark-green body text #081913 and mobile-menu amber #F5A300. The logo uses black/white with source flag red #ED1C24.
White text on green, terracotta, light green or cyan does not reach 4.5:1. These templates use charcoal text on those accents. Verify the final pair and type size in Colour.
No official Pantone or CMYK recipes were found. Website colours are observations, not print specifications.

elements.text: Observed on home, Projects, methodology, governance, donate and contact pages. A supported default for short, large display headings.
Observed body, navigation and supporting type. Regular and Bold set these applications; Italic is an additional document-emphasis choice.

Some live project-detail H1 elements match the DK Brush Crush CSS rule; H3 rules declare Acumin Pro Condensed. Those commercial fonts are not bundled. Local web body starts at 18 px / 1.5; document body at 10.5 pt / 1.45.
The logo’s custom wordmark is vector artwork. Never replace it with Bahianita, Red Hat Text or typed letters.

Add verified local information and sources. The 48 mm document logo, 8 mm reserved space and 20 mm margins are local defaults, not published brand rules.

pages.name: Presentation and digital
pages.title: Carry the same identity into each format
pages.subtitle: Editable slide, social and email applications with explicit placeholders.

elements.text: Six slides support an opening, section break, content, evidence, before/after comparison and community voice. Social and email layouts keep content editable.
Use approved project photography and captions. Partner logos and endorsements need separate confirmation.

pages.name: Local sizing and spacing
pages.title: Practical defaults you can apply
pages.subtitle: These are local recommendations. Official minimum sizes and numeric clear space remain unverified.

elements.text: Reserve = one quarter of logo height
Use 48 mm on report covers. Retain the document profile’s 8 mm reserve when it is larger than the proportional space.
This is a conservative starting point for the primary mark. Review small secondary marks at actual size and proof printed output.
Keep the original proportions and red flag. The reserve is surrounding layout space; it does not change the logo canvas or its source paths.

pages.name: Project content pattern
pages.title: Give each project a complete record
pages.subtitle: A proposed brief and a documented project profile have different jobs.

elements.text: Name the community, city and country. Add a verified project number only when the project source supports it. Record the period or project stage.
Describe local leadership, participation, access and ongoing care. Name partners by their role. Keep estimates and proposed activities explicit.
Credit images and give dates and sources for factual claims. Project records, news and site labels can disagree; verify the relevant project.

pages.name: Images, voices and evidence
pages.title: Make the evidence easy to understand
pages.subtitle: New comparison, quotation and metric layouts keep their context editable.

elements.text: Identify the same place, both dates and the image creator. A visual change does not establish every claimed social outcome.
Use an exact approved quotation, speaker role, place and source. Identify translated wording.
Metric cards need a measure, unit, geography, period and source. Label a target or estimate. Keep annual reach, unique participants and visits distinct.

pages.name: Audiences and languages
pages.title: Make the next step relevant
pages.subtitle: Website audiences inform the content; these layouts and copy structures are local choices.

elements.text: Describe a place, its priorities and local leadership. Use the current community-enquiry route.
Explain the proposed contribution and next conversation. Keep partner identities in a separate attribution area.
Choose the current giving program and destination. Keep donation amounts and anniversary campaigns out of permanent brand tokens.
Keep love.fútbol unchanged. Preserve names and accents, allow natural wrapping, review translations locally and match the link’s language.
One primary action per layout. Verify its destination before publishing. The kit has editable content and multilingual guidance; its interface remains English.

pages.name: Maps and places
pages.title: Put each place on a quiet map
pages.subtitle: Local choices from an unofficial companion atlas, informed by the website palette. Not official love.fútbol cartography.

elements.text: Labels: charcoal with an off-white halo. The seven basemap values are atlas choices, not observed brand colours; the lens and markers reuse observed palette keys. Pitch marker and walk ring are explained on the next page.
Treat locations as approximate. Most come from the homepage map; others are geocoded from the place named on a profile.

pages.name: Markers, areas and data
pages.title: Let each mark say one thing
pages.subtitle: Marker colours, area outlines and source rules used by the atlas. Local application choices; keep their sources visible.

elements.text: Amber: no profile page to open
A map symbol, never the logo
Countries by number of mapped projects
Bahianita for country and project names, counters and large numbers. Red Hat Text for the interface, legends and sources.
Photographs show in grayscale and return to colour on hover or focus, following the grayscale class on the website’s project grid.

Name every source beside its figure: Wikidata, World Bank, U.S. Census ACS via Census Reporter, OpenStreetMap. Show the year of each population. Area statistics describe an administrative area, not the people a space serves.
Never imply love.fútbol produced third-party statistics. Quote its own counters as dated, attributed figures: pages disagree. Use project numbers only where a source gives them and note conflicts.
Coordinates are approximate: say where each came from.

pages.name: Atlas icons and patterns
pages.title: Supporting graphics for places
pages.subtitle: Original 24 px map icons and logo-free patterns. They never replace, repeat or abstract the complete logo.

elements.text: Icons: 1.75 stroke, round caps and joins, drawn in the current text colour. Pair each with a visible label. Patterns use palette colours and linework only; place the complete logo separately with its full reserve.

pages.name: Sources and open questions
pages.title: Keep evidence with the assets
pages.subtitle: The research record separates published facts, observed implementations and local choices.

elements.text: Original vector paths and source PDF. Official website logo reference. Sanitized Projects-page evidence. Source URLs and hashes. Original open-licence font files.
A current official brand standards manual; minimum sizes; numeric clear space; print recipes; partner lockup rules; official stationery and motion guidance.

Research: docs/RESEARCH.md and docs/SITE-RESEARCH.md. Working defaults: docs/APPLICATION-GUIDE.md and reference/application-assumptions.json. Maps and places: docs/ATLAS.md and reference/atlas-cartography.json. Evidence and source index: reference/.
Rebuild with npm run make:lovefutbol. Update source evidence before changing a claimed brand rule. Public availability does not grant blanket permission for trademarks or photography.
